chunks: And he, peace be upon him and his family, said to Fatimah, peace be upon her, when Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib was killed:
"Do not supplicate with humiliation, bereavement, or desolation; and whatever you said about him, you have spoken the truth."

key_terms.تَدْعِي: to supplicate or invoke in speech
key_terms.جَعْفَرُ: Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib, whose death is being referred to
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, the daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say to Fāṭimah عليها السلام after the death of Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم addressing Fāṭimah عليها السلام at the time of Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib’s death. He instructed her regarding the form of expression in grief and affirmed the truthfulness of what she had said about Jaʿfar.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.521 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said to Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A} when Ja'far ibn Abi Talib was martyred:
"Do not supplicate with (expressions of) humiliation, loss, or desolation. Whatever you have said about him is true."
